name: Alistair McGregor
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, through a family friend who worked as a mechanic for a local rally team. Fascinated by the blend of precision and human grit, he pursued a business degree with a focus on human resources, specifically targeting the motorsport industry. He believes in fostering a challenging yet supportive environment, pushing individuals to achieve their full potential while ensuring their well-being.

At EKS JC, Alistair is known for his rigorous approach to talent acquisition and development. He's not afraid to make tough decisions and holds everyone to a high standard. His keen eye for detail allows him to identify potential issues before they escalate, making him a valuable asset to the team's operational efficiency. Alistair's dedication to process and fairness ensures a balanced and productive atmosphere, contributing significantly to the team's overall success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed, with a slight side part.
physical.description: Alistair has a serious demeanor and a sharp, observant gaze.
